title: Cooling-Priority Sensitivity and Rank-Stability Validation

controlled_oat.procedure: multiply one CRITIC weight at a time, then renormalize all six weights to sum to 1

monte_carlo.procedure: multiply all six baseline weights simultaneously by independent bounded factors, then renormalize to sum to 1
monte_carlo.interpretation: stress-test scenarios, not statistical confidence intervals

equal_weight_benchmark.interpretation: alternative benchmark only; does not replace CRITIC

topsis.ranking: descending score; grid_id only breaks exact score ties

robustness_threshold_policy: No arbitrary numerical robustness threshold is used as a computational PASS/FAIL gate. Step33 reports the observed stability evidence.

priority_classification.reason: Sensitivity validation does not itself provide a scientifically unique High/Medium/Low threshold. Continuous score, rank and percentile remain the primary decision outputs.
